displayDescription: An idea sticker spawns a linked Memphis network on a deep-indigo halftone field with ring pulse and confetti.
limitations: Flat digital vector approximation of Memphis print graphics; no paper or ink texture simulated.

Background moved from the cream example swatch to a scene-dependent deep indigo; accent tokens #ED718E, #3DBAB1, #F4C64F and ink #202039 keep their roles, with white keylines added for contrast on the dark field.
Motion and mo.js were reviewed but not used; GSAP alone owns every animated property, and confetti trajectories are authored constants.
Uses system Arial Black / Arial fonts.
